items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: He was my drinking man... We was close.

ctx.x: No. But anyway, this trumpet player, me and him was in the bar and Fate come in and this boy, "Hey, Chief, come here, I want you to meet somebody." So that's how I met him. And he was such a pleasant guy from then on. He was my drinking man, because he used to ask me a lot of questions about the band and -- Fate Marable, him and his gin. We was close.
How did you like his band?
